learning_objectives: Students should be able to explain Fourier Transform in simple language.
Students should understand the difference between time domain and frequency domain.
Students should describe how a complex signal can be decomposed into simple waves.
Students should connect Fourier Transform to at least one real-world application.
lesson_material: Fourier Transform converts a signal from the time domain into the frequency domain.
